Name: Blonde Haired Elliot
Author: joyous1ariella
Description:
New portraits and sprites that make Elliot blonde, while keeping his vanilla style.

I also slightly tweaked the skin color of the portraits since he looked rather yellow with his new hair color.

Inspired by [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/221/?]this hilarious mod.[/url]

Enjoy!
-Ariella

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Installation for the Sprites:
[list=1]
[*]Navigate to your Stardew Valley game folder and go to the Content-->Characters folder (mine is at C:\GOG Games\Stardew Valley\Content\Characters)
[*]MAKE A COPY OF Elliot.xnb FOR BACKUP!
[*]Extract the file from the "Characters" to that folder using [url=http://www.rarlab.com/download.htm]WinRar[/url] or similar program and overwrite the file.
[/list]
Installation for the Portraits:
[list=1]
[*]Navigate to your Stardew Valley game folder and go to the Content-->Portaits folder (mine is at C:\GOG Games\Stardew Valley\Content\Portraits)
[*]MAKE A COPY OF Elliot.xnb FOR BACKUP!
[*]Extract the file from "Portraits" to that folder using [url=http://www.rarlab.com/download.htm]WinRar[/url] or similar program and overwrite the file.
[/list]
